cohort: 119 women with type 1 diabetes and 814 women with gestational diabetes
finding: ILPS treatment during pregnancy was associated with lower fasting blood glucose at the end of pregnancy, lower rates of caesarean section and preterm delivery, and fewer babies with excessive ponderal index or neonatal hypoglycemic episodes compared to NPH insulin.
mod_finding: Caesarean section and preterm delivery rates were significantly lower in the ILPS group compared to the NPH group.
